capabilities: Parse English and Spanish date phrases, ranges and sequences
Insert links to date notes from @ mentions while typing
Own daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly note settings and templates
Write dates into properties or at the cursor with configurable commands
Show a sidebar calendar with activity dots
extras: README has a Spanish translation (README.es.md). Times of day and languages other than English and Spanish are listed as not yet supported. The calendar layout is adapted from Liam Cain's Calendar plugin under MIT.
intentEvidence: Date Compass replaces the Periodic Notes plugin.
problem: Typing dates in Obsidian means writing ISO dates by hand and building links to periodic notes manually.

relations.evidence: Date Compass replaces the Periodic Notes plugin.
This is the replacement for nldates.parseDate(...).
The layout comes from Liam Cain's Calendar plugin (MIT)
Automatic (Templater when it is enabled, otherwise core Templates, otherwise Date Compass itself)
The filter works like the note filters of Note Compass and of Bases

summary: Natural-language date parser that turns typed English or Spanish phrases into links to daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes.
